name: Taunt
description: Must attack the one who taunted it. {stacks} turn(s) left.

name: Burn
description: Searing: takes {damage} damage at the start of the enemy phase, ignoring Block. Short but hot: {stacks} turn(s) left, never more than 4. New Burn adds turns.

name: Poison
description: Toxic and slow: takes {damage} damage at the start of the enemy phase (one per stack), ignoring Block, then loses 1 stack. Stacks without limit.

name: Bleed
description: Open wound: every attack that deals HP damage makes it lose {stacks} more HP, ignoring Block, then Bleed drops by 1. It never fades on its own.

name: Chill
description: Frozen to the bone: -{initiative} initiative (acts later) and takes +{vulnerable}% Physical damage. At 0 initiative an enemy is Frozen and loses its next turn (the Chill shatters). {stacks} stack(s), max 5, -1 per round.

name: Soaked
description: Drenched in sea water: takes +{vulnerable}% Lightning and Frost damage. {stacks} stack(s), max 3, -1 per round.

name: Sandblind
description: Sand in the eyes: deals 25% less attack damage. {stacks} turn(s) left, max 3.

name: Quicksand
description: Sinking sand: the party draws 1 fewer card at the start of its next {stacks} turn(s) (never more than 1 fewer, however many sink).

name: Oiled
description: Slick with oil: deals 15% less attack damage and takes +{vulnerable}% Fire damage. {stacks} stack(s), max 3, -1 per round.

name: Blight
description: Marked for death: at the start of the enemy phase, after Poison and Burn, it perishes if its HP is {stacks} or less. Blight never fades.

name: Frostbitten
description: Numb with cold: takes +{vulnerable}% Frost damage. {stacks} stack(s), max 3, -1 per round.
